plan.hypothesis: Ambiguous image groups can be excluded from sparse color auditing without discarding clean observations in the rest of each track.
plan.acceptance: Keep one vote per track/distinct training-image pair; reject every ambiguous image group; never decode holdout colors; old unambiguous contributions unchanged; source/new cached audits identical. No training quality or speed claim.
plan.limits: Point error <4px, per-observation residual <=2px, at least 2 clean training images, minimum 20 tracks per reported eligible camera pair; sparse support is not surface truth.
